name: Retry Now
description: NAKISO's Miku track, 145 BPM and 2:02. A steady beat with chords on the strongest hits, so it makes a good first song. Easy is gentle.

name: Take A Slice
description: A slow-feeling 76 BPM groove from Glass Animals, charted in double time so there's always something to hit. At 3:50 it's about staying steady.

name: ラビットホール
description: DECO*27 at about 173 BPM, the fastest song in the game. Start on Easy and work up.

name: Slaughter House
description: Sematary, 118 BPM and 3:09. The chart follows the sound: low hits land in the left lanes and higher ones on the right.
Arctic Monkeys, 140 BPM and 4:13. A long song with space between the busy parts, so pace yourself.

name: The Other Side Of Paradise
description: Glass Animals, 128 BPM and 5:20, the longest song here. A steady, endurance-style chart.

name: cosmic relief
description: nelward, a laid-back 86 BPM and 2:36. The hold-note showcase: 71 of its 307 notes are long, so keep the key down while your other hand keeps tapping.

name: アブノーマリティ・ダンシンガール
description: ぐちり, 110 BPM and 3:28. From the album 憂象夢象. A lighter chart with room to breathe.

name: ヴァンパイア
description: DECO*27 feat. Hatsune Miku, 82 BPM and 3:00. From the Magical Mirai 10th Anniversary album. A dense chart, so try Easy or Normal first.

name: FAILURE GIRL
description: Kairikibear, 120 BPM and 3:25. From the album ELECTROSTATIC GIRL. A steady chart that suits most players.

name: 愛して 愛して 愛して
description: Kikuo, 77 BPM and 4:12. From the album きくおミク3. A dense chart, so try Easy or Normal first.

name: 指切り
description: すこっぷ, 98 BPM and 2:49. A single release. A dense chart, so try Easy or Normal first.

name: DARLING
description: Maretu, 174 BPM and 3:44. From the album SIU. A dense chart, so try Easy or Normal first.

name: Mind brand
description: Maretu, 78 BPM and 4:19. From the album Coin locker Baby. A dense chart, so try Easy or Normal first.

name: Young Girl A
description: Siinamota, 130 BPM and 3:42. From the album Alive. A steady chart that suits most players.

name: White Ball
description: Miracle Musical, 72 BPM and 3:35, from the album Hawaii: Part II. A hold-note chart: 46 of its 543 notes are long, so keep the key down until the tail ends while your other hand keeps tapping.

name: Isle Unto Thyself
description: Miracle Musical, 74 BPM and 3:47, from the album Hawaii: Part II. Taps only, with no long notes.
